sql: select e.key exp, 'v'||v.version ver, g.gate_key, g.kind, g.from_state||'>'||coalesce(g.to_state,'') tr, (g.superseded_by_gate_id is null) cur, (select r.verdict||' '||to_char(r.computed_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') from experiment_gate_results r where r.gate_id=g.id order by r.computed_at desc limit 1) last, g.spec_json::text spec from experiment_gates g join experiment_versions v on v.id=g.version_id join experiments e on e.id=v.experiment_id where e.state<>'RETIRED' and e.key like 'mmsell%' order by e.key, v.version, g.gate_key
